_comment: Copy to harness.config.json (gitignored) and fill in for your host. See harness/README.md.

providerConfig._comment: Opaque, harness-owned settings. The bridge never reads this — it is passed through to the spawned harness's own environment/config only if that harness expects it there. Prefer configuring the harness's own provider settings (e.g. opencode's own config file, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.) directly rather than relying on this field, unless a given harness documents reading it from here.
